sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.content: Establish access control requirements to protect AgentAegis's information systems and data from unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 2. Principles
sub_items: Least Privilege: Users receive minimum access required for their role
Need-to-Know: Access to data granted only when required for job function
Separation of Duties: No single individual should control all aspects of a critical process

sections.heading: 3. Account Management
sub_items: All access requires formal request and management approval
Accounts provisioned within 24 hours of approved request
Access removed within 24 hours of employment termination
Accounts disabled after 90 days of inactivity
Service accounts documented and reviewed quarterly

sections.heading: 4. Authentication
sub_items: Multi-factor authentication required for all accounts
Admin accounts: hardware security keys required

sections.heading: 5. Access Reviews
sections.content: User access reviews conducted quarterly. IT manager certify access appropriateness for their teams.

sections.heading: 6. Remote Access
sections.content: Access to cloud systems requires SSO via corporate identity provider. Direct credential access prohibited.
